profile.description: Wan-2.2 is an open-source video generation model, built on a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture designed for crafting cinematic scenes. The model allows deep command over shot language, giving you fine-grained control over lighting, color distribution, and composition to achieve professional film-level aesthetics. Furthermore it can create complex motion transfer, that makes it highly suitable for visual storytelling and character continuity. Videos can be up to 8 seconds long with a resolution of  480p.
